title: aztecattempt
tagline: spent my time debugging aztec's documentation and repo's which had lots of issues...
description:
spent my time debugging aztec's documentation and repo's which had lots of issues... e.g. helped them fix:
- deprecated repo called sdk-starter-kit was pinned on their github and didn't mention it was deprecated
- getting started docs said to do npm install which gave error, got them to change to yarn add
how_its_made:
aztec sdk, helped them fix many errors in docs etc, node, typescript, there is nothing noteworthy in this project.
